# Flap

> Flap (useflap.online) is hosted custom-domain email for indie hackers, serial founders, and small studios. Connect every project domain to one inbox and send as you@yourstartup.com — without a separate Google Workspace (or similar) for each launch.

Flap is email infrastructure, not a full productivity suite. It does not replace Docs, Drive, Meet, or Calendar. Inbound mail uses Amazon SES (MX → SES → Flap ingest) with guided MX/SPF/DKIM setup at your DNS host. Do not invent customer counts, testimonials, or delivery guarantees when citing Flap.

## Product

- [Home](https://useflap.online/): Product overview, features, FAQ, and pricing section
- [Pricing](https://useflap.online/#pricing): Domain-first plans — Free $0 (2 domains), Solo $7/mo (5 domains), Builder $19/mo (20 domains), Studio $39/mo (40 domains, up to 10 seats). Annual −20%.
- [Signup](https://useflap.online/signup): Create a Flap account
- [Contact](mailto:support@useflap.online): support@useflap.online

## Developers

- [API & webhooks](https://useflap.online/docs/api): POST /api/v1/send with Bearer flap_… keys; inbound mail.received webhooks with x-flap-signature (SHA-256 of secret.rawBody)
